desc: ICE-SHROOM stage0: simple recognizable modern PvZ2 Ice-shroom with a small clustered BLUE CRYSTAL mushroom CAP, curved cyan caprim and just a few tiny attached underside icicles, squat rounded pale-turquoise frosted stalk with friendly WHITEeyes/blueirises and small UPWARD smile. Flared flat continuous stalk base, small attached ice facets. No angry scowl, no fangs or clenched teeth. Basic compact mushroom proportions; cap clearly separated from face-stalk.

FROST-SHROOM stage1: natural grown crystalline Ice-shroom extension. Wider fuller blue crystal-pillar CAP with extra layers of cyan/blue faceted crystals and slightlylonger attached rim icicles. Stocky pale-turquoise frosted stalk with friendly openWHITEeyes/blueirises, raised relaxedbrows and little UPWARD smile, continuouslyflared flatbase with attached ice facets. Keep mushroom cap-on-stalk silhouette, not a pile of crystal spikes with a face pasted on.

BLIZZARD-SHROOM stage2: final natural Ice-shroom evolution with broad impressive jagged BLUE CRYSTAL mushroom cap, tall overlapping blue/cyan faceted crystal pillars on continuous curved icy rim and a few attached icicles underneath. Broad sturdy pale-turquoise frosted stalk-face, friendly WHITEeyes with blueirises and small UPWARD smile, continuous flatflared base with restrained connected icefrills. Strong crystalcap silhouette, NO angry brows, humanoidicebody, gold crown, floating aura or detached shards. Keep actual recognizable modern PvZ2 mushroom anatomy.
